description: This header defines civil time abstractions and classes (e.g., CivilDay, CivilSecond) for handling human-readable date and time components, including construction, normalization, comparison, arithmetic, formatting, and parsing, within the Abseil time library.

classes.name: CivilSecond
classes.description: A civil time class representing seconds, aligned to the second boundary.

classes.name: CivilMinute
classes.description: A civil time class representing minutes, aligned to the minute boundary.

classes.name: CivilHour
classes.description: A civil time class representing hours, aligned to the hour boundary.

classes.name: CivilDay
classes.description: A civil time class representing days, aligned to the day boundary.

classes.name: CivilMonth
classes.description: A civil time class representing months, aligned to the month boundary.

classes.name: CivilYear
classes.description: A civil time class representing years, aligned to the year boundary.

methods.name: FormatCivilTime
methods.description: Formats civil time objects into string representations based on their type.

methods.name: ParseCivilTime
methods.description: Parses civil time objects from strings with exact format matching.

methods.name: ParseLenientCivilTime
methods.description: Parses civil time objects from strings with more flexible format matching.

methods.name: AbslParseFlag
methods.description: Parses command-line flag strings into civil time objects.

methods.name: AbslUnparseFlag
methods.description: Converts civil time objects into command-line flag string representations.
